title: The Supremacy of God's Son

questions.question: Long ago, at many times and in many ways, God spoke to our fathers by the ____,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:1 (ESV): "Long ago, at many times and in many ways, God spoke to our fathers by the prophets,"

questions.question: but in these last days he has spoken to us by his ____, whom he appointed the heir of all things,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:2 (ESV): "but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed the heir of all things, through whom also he created the world."

questions.question: He is the radiance of the ____ of God and the exact imprint of his nature,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:3 (ESV): "He is the radiance of the glory of God and the exact imprint of his nature, and he upholds the universe by the word of his power..."

questions.question: and he upholds the universe by the word of his ____.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:3 (ESV): "...and he upholds the universe by the word of his power. After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,"

questions.question: After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the ____ on high,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:3 (ESV): "...After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,"

questions.question: having become as much superior to ____ as the name he has inherited is more excellent than theirs.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:4 (ESV): "having become as much superior to angels as the name he has inherited is more excellent than theirs."

questions.question: For to which of the angels did God ever say, "You are my Son, today I have ____ you"?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:5 (ESV): "For to which of the angels did God ever say, 'You are my Son, today I have begotten you'?"

questions.question: And again, when he brings the firstborn into the world, he says, "Let all God's ____ worship him."
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:6 (ESV): "And again, when he brings the firstborn into the world, he says, 'Let all God's angels worship him.'"

questions.question: Of the angels he says, "He makes his angels winds, and his ministers a ____ of fire."
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:7 (ESV): "Of the angels he says, 'He makes his angels winds, and his ministers a flame of fire.'"

questions.question: But of the Son he says, "Your ____, O God, is forever and ever, the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom."
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:8 (ESV): "But of the Son he says, 'Your throne, O God, is forever and ever, the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom.'"

questions.question: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of ____ beyond your companions.
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:9 (ESV): "You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions."

questions.question: And, "You, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the ____ are the work of your hands;"
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:10 (ESV): "And, 'You, Lord, laid the foundation of the earth in the beginning, and the heavens are the work of your hands;'"

questions.question: they will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a ____,
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:11 (ESV): "they will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment,"

questions.question: And to which of the angels has he ever said, "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a ____ for your feet"?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:13 (ESV): "And to which of the angels has he ever said, 'Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet'?"

questions.question: Are they (angels) not all ____ spirits sent out to serve for the sake of those who are to inherit salvation?
questions.explanation: Hebrews 1:14 (ESV): "Are they not all ministering spirits sent out to serve for the sake of those who are to inherit salvation?"

key_verse_text: He is the radiance of the glory of God and the exact imprint of his nature, and he upholds the universe by the word of his power. After making purification for sins, he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty on high,
